name: Update Metadata Repository
description: TUF-compliant metadata repository with versioned metadata, threshold signatures, and expiration.
purpose: Host a TUF-compliant metadata repository that clients query for update metadata, ensuring freshness, authenticity, and integrity of the update process.
acceptanceCriteria: TUF metadata repository is deployed and serves root, targets, snapshot, and timestamp metadata.
Metadata is versioned (monotonically increasing version numbers).
Threshold signatures are enforced: root metadata requires multi-signature approval.
All metadata files include expiration timestamps and are refreshed before expiry.
Repository supports metadata delegation (targets can delegate to child roles).
Repository is available over HTTPS with TLS.
Repository health is monitored (metadata freshness, signature validity, disk usage).
Recovery procedure exists for expired metadata or key rotation scenarios.
